title: Western intelligence warns of Iranian cyber threats targeting dissidents
english: Intelligence agencies from the U.S., U.K., and the Netherlands have issued a joint warning regarding Iranian state-linked hackers using specialized spyware called 'CHOSEN BRICK' to target dissidents living abroad. This malicious software is deployed through deceptive messages on platforms like WhatsApp and Telegram to steal private data and silence critics of the Iranian government. Authorities emphasize that these ongoing cyber operations are part of a broader effort by Iran's Ministry of Intelligence to monitor and intimidate its opposition globally.
amharic: የአሜሪካ፣ የእንግሊዝ እና የኔዘርላንድስ የስለላ ተቋማት ኢራን በውጭ አገር የሚኖሩ ተቃዋሚዎቿን ለመከታተል 'CHOSEN BRICK' በተባለ የሰላይ ሶፍትዌር እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ሶፍትዌር በተለይ በዋትስአፕ እና በቴሌግራም መልእክቶች አማካይነት የግል መረጃዎችን ለመስረቅ እና በኢራን መንግሥት ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ትችቶችን ለማፈን ያገለግላል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች የኢራን የስለላ ሚኒስቴር ተቃዋሚዎቹን ለመቆጣጠር እና ለማስፈራራት ከሚጠቀምባቸው ስልቶች መካከል ዋነኞቹ ናቸው።
oromo: Qaamoleen basaastotaa Ameerikaa, UK fi Nezerlaandii, mootummaan Iraan biyyoota alaa keessa jiraattota isaa kanneen mormitoota ta'an hordofuuf 'CHOSEN BRICK' jedhamuun beekamuun akka fayyadamu akeekkachiisaniiru. Sooftiweerichi kun ergaawwan gowwoomsaa kanneen akka WhatsApp fi Telegram fayyadamuun odeeffannoo dhunfaa hatuufi mormitoota cal'isiisuuf gargaara. Qondaaltonni akka ibsanitti, gochaaleen biyyattii kun mootummaan Iraan mormitoota isaa addunyaa guutuu keessatti hordofuufi sodaachisuuf tarsiimoo itti fayyadamuudha.

title: Kennedy Center closes amid financial crisis and Trump name dispute
english: The Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. has officially closed its doors due to a severe financial crisis and ongoing building maintenance issues. The center's board, appointed by President Donald Trump, insists that the facility's future depends on adding the President's name to the structure, a move recently blocked by a federal judge. The court ruled that any such renaming requires explicit approval from Congress, leading to further tension between the board and the judiciary.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኘው የኬኔዲ ማዕከል ከባድ የገንዘብ ችግር እና የህንጻ ጥገና እጦት በመጥቀስ በሮቹን ዘግቷል። በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተሾሙት የማዕከሉ አስተዳደር ቦርድ ህንጻው እንዲተርፍ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ስም በግንባታው ላይ መጻፍ አለበት ብለው ቢያምኑም፣ የፌዴራል ዳኛ ይህንን ውሳኔ ከልክለዋል። ዳኛው ማናቸውንም የስም ለውጥ ለማድረግ የኮንግረስ ፈቃድ እንደሚያስፈልግ በመወሰናቸው በቦርዱ እና በህግ አካላት መካከል ውዝግብ ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: ማዕከል ኬኔዲ kan Washington, D.C. keessatti argamu, rakkoo faayinaansii cimaa fi fedhii haaromsa irraa kan ka'e balbala isaa cufateera. Boordiin maaddiichaa kan Pirezidaant Doolaard Tiraampiin muudaman, haala kana fooyyessuuf maqaan Pirezidaantichaa iddoo sanatti barreeffamuu qaba jedhanii falmaa jiru. Haata'u malee, abbaan murtee federaalaa jijjiirraan maqaa kamiyyuu heeyyama koongeerasiin alatti akka hin raawwatamne murteessuun, walitti bu'iinsa boordichaa fi mana murtee gidduutti uumeera.

title: Badar Khan Suri blasts 'shallow' Trump administration at immigration hearing
english: Georgetown University scholar Badar Khan Suri has criticized the Trump administration’s attempts to deport him, labeling their legal arguments as baseless and politically motivated. Suri, an Indian citizen and legal U.S. resident married to an American, believes he is being targeted for his public advocacy regarding Palestinian rights. He maintains that the government's accusations of antisemitism are merely a strategy to justify his removal from the country.
amharic: የጆርጅታውን ዩኒቨርሲቲ ምሁር የሆኑት ባዳር ካን ሱሪ፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከሀገር ለማስወጣት የሚያቀርበውን ክስ መሰረተ ቢስ እና ፖለቲካዊ ፍላጎት ያዘለ ነው ሲሉ አጣጥለዋል። የህንድ ዜግነት ያላቸው እና በአሜሪካ ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ያላቸው ሱሪ፣ ለፍልስጤማውያን መብት በመሟገታቸው ምክንያት ኢላማ እንደተደረጉ ይናገራሉ። መንግስት በከፈቱባቸው ክሶች አማካኝነት ፖለቲካዊ አጀንዳቸውን ለማራመድ እየሞከሩ ነው ሲሉም አስተያየታቸውን ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun Yuunivarsitii Joorjiitaawunii Badar Khaan Surii, mootummaan Traamp isaan biyyattii irraa ari'uuf yaalii gochuutti jiru kun bu'uura kan hin qabneefi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Lammii Hindii fi jiraataa seeraa kan ta'an Surii, garaagarummaa mirga Paalastiyinotaaf falmuu isaaniitiin qofa akka xiyyeeffannoo mootummaa ta'an amanu. Mootummaan yakka isaan irratti dhiyeessu kun, ajandaa siyaasaa isaanii qofa galmaan ga'uuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Badar Khan Suri blasts 'shallow' Trump administration at immigration hearing
english: Georgetown scholar Badar Khan Suri is currently fighting deportation, criticizing the Trump administration's legal claims against him as baseless and politically motivated. Supporters and academic colleagues argue that the government is targeting him to harass his wife, who is from Gaza, due to her family background. Suri maintains that his legal troubles stem from his vocal support for Palestinian rights rather than any actual wrongdoing.
amharic: የጆርጅታውን ዩኒቨርሲቲ ምሁር ባዳር ካን ሱሪ በመንግስት የቀረበባቸውን የውጭ ሀገር ዜጋ የማስወጣት ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የሚያቀርባቸው መከራከሪያዎች መሰረተ ቢስ እና ፖለቲካዊ ፍላጎት ያላቸው መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል። የሱሪ ደጋፊዎች እና የሥራ ባልደረቦች እንደሚሉት፣ መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው ከጋዛ የመጣችውን ባለቤታቸውን ለማንገላታት ነው። ሱሪ ችግሩ የተፈጠረው ለፍልስጤም መብቶች በመቆማቸው እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun Yuunivarsitii Joorjiitawn Baadaar Kaan Suurii, mootummaan Tiramp karaa seeraa biyyaa isa baasuuf yaaluu isaa balaaleffatee, himannaan kun bu'uura kan hin qabneefi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabu ta'uu ibse. Deeggartoonniifi gahiin hojii isaa akka jedhanitti, mootummaan kana kan godhe haadha manaa isaa ishee Gaazaa irraa dhuftetti garmalee miidhuufi. Suuriin rakkoon kun kan isa mudate falmaa mirga Falastiiniif taasisaa jiruun wal qabatee akka ta'e dubbata.

title: Israeli strike on tents in Gaza kills two Palestinians, including a child
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting temporary shelters in Gaza's Al-Mawasi region resulted in the deaths of two individuals, among them an eight-year-old girl. At least 14 additional people sustained injuries during the incident. These tents were being used by displaced civilians seeking safety in the area.
amharic: በጋዛ አል-ማዋሲ አካባቢ በሚገኙ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ላይ የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች ባደረሱት ጥቃት አንድ የ8 ዓመት ህፃን ልጅን ጨምሮ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በዚህ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እነዚህ መጠለያዎች ከቀያቸው የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች መጠለያ ሆነው ያገለግሉ ነበር።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo Al-Mawasi kan Gazaatti iddoolee namoonni buqqa'an keessa jiraatan irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa gaggeesseen, mucittii umriin ishee waggaa saddeet ta'e dabalatee namoonni lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni 14 ol ta'an miidhaniiru. Iddoon kun namoota buqqa'anii godoo keessa jiraachaa turan irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Rubio, Omani foreign minister discuss Iranian attacks and Hormuz shipping
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio held talks with Oman's Foreign Minister to address rising tensions caused by Iranian aggression in the region. Rubio condemned Iran's recent attacks on commercial vessels and emphasized the American commitment to maintaining maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, he reaffirmed the US position that Iran must be prevented from developing nuclear weapons.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኢራን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ለመወያየት ከኦማን አቻቸው ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ሩቢዮ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት በማውገዝ፣ በአካባቢው የባህር ላይ ደህንነትን ለማስጠበቅ አሜሪካ ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። እንዲሁም ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል አሜሪካ ያላትን ጠንካራ አቋም አስታውሰዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo, gochaa hammeenyaa Iraaniin naannichatti raawwatamaa jiru irratti mari'achuuf ministira dhimma alaa Omaan waliin walga'aniiru. Ruubiyoon weerara dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti raawwatamu balaaleffachuun, nageenya galaana Ormuz eeguuf Ameerikaan kutannoo qabaachuu ishee mirkaneessaniiru. Kana malees, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf Ameerikaan akka cimtee itti fufu ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Consequences of raising my voice’: Leqaa Kordia suffers fifth seizure since ICE detention
english: Palestinian activist Leqaa Kordia reports that she has experienced her fifth seizure since being released from a year-long detention by U.S. immigration authorities in March. Kordia, who had no history of seizures prior to her incarceration, believes the medical condition is a result of the trauma and inadequate care she faced while in custody. She continues to struggle with these ongoing health issues and the lasting impact of her imprisonment on her daily life.
amharic: የፍልስጤም አክቲቪስት ለቃ ኮርዲያ ከአንድ ዓመት እስር በኋላ በነፃነት ከተለቀቀች ወዲህ ለአምስተኛ ጊዜ የሚጥል በሽታ እንዳጋጠማት አስታውቃለች። ኮርዲያ ከእስሯ በፊት እንዲህ አይነት የጤና እክል እንዳልነበረባት በመግለጽ፣ የጤና እክሉ በእስር ቤት በቆየችበት ወቅት በደረሰባት ድብርት እና በቂ ህክምና ባለማግኘቷ እንደመጣ ታምናለች። እስካሁንም ድረስ ከዚህ የጤና ችግር እና ከእስር ቤቱ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ጋር ትታገላለች።
oromo: Leqaa Kordia jedhamtuu fi falmituu mirgaa kan taate lammii Paalestaayinii, ji'a Bitootessaa waggaa tokko booda hidhaa godaantotaa keessaa erga baatee as yeroo shanaffaaf dhukkubbiin kukkuftee (seizure) akka ishee mudate ibsiteetti. Kordia hidhamuu ishee dura dhukkuba kana akka hin qabne kan himtu yoo ta'u, rakkinni fayyaa kun miidhaa qaamaa fi sammuu akkasumas walitti fufiinsa dhabachuu wal’aansa fayyaa isheen yeroo hidhaa keessa turte ishee mudate irraa kan dhufe akka ta'e amanti. Yeroo ammaa kana rakkoo fayyaa kanaa fi miidhaa sammuu hidhaan ishee irra ga'e waliin qabsoo gochaa jirti.

title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
english: The United States recently announced the deployment of a secretive space weapon, citing the need to defend its forces against potential adversaries. Experts suggest this hardware likely functions as an electronic jamming tool to disable enemy communications, though they have not ruled out more aggressive technologies designed to physically collide with or grapple other satellites. This development highlights an intensifying global competition, as world powers increasingly prioritize military dominance in space through advanced technology.
amharic: አሜሪካ የራሷን የጦር ኃይል ከጠላት ጥቃት ለመከላከል በሚል ምህዋር ውስጥ ሚስጥራዊ የጠፈር መሣሪያ ማሰማራቷን ይፋ አድርጋለች። የጠፈር ጉዳይ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ይህ መሣሪያ የጠላትን የመገናኛ ዘዴዎች የሚያስተጓጉል የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሣሪያ ሊሆን ይችላል፤ ነገር ግን ሌሎች ሳተላይቶችን በአካል መግጨት ወይም መያዝ የሚችሉ አደገኛ ቴክኖሎጂዎች የመሆን እድልም አለው። ይህ ክስተት ሀያላን መንግሥታት በጠፈር ውስጥ የበላይነትን ለመቀዳጀት እያደረጉት ያለውን ከፍተኛ ውድድር በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Amerika humna ishee ittisuuf jechuun meeshaa waraanaa icciitii qabu gara hawaatti erguushee beeksisteetti. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, meeshaan kun quunnamtii diinaa addaan kutuuf kan gargaaru ta'uu mala; haa ta'u malee, satalaayitoota biroo rukutuun ykn qabachuun mancaasuu kan danda'an meeshaalee gurguddoo ta'uu irrattis shakkii qabu. Tarkaanfiin kun hawaa keessatti biyyoonni gurguddoon dorgommii waraanaa akka daran hammaataa jiran kan argisiisuudha.

title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
english: Two sailors are missing and 23 have been rescued after a Panama-flagged oil tanker caught fire following an attack in the Strait of Hormuz. While Iran claims the vessel hit naval mines, the US military reports that the ship was struck by a drone. This incident is part of a series of maritime attacks in the region that have caused multiple casualties since late February.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በተፈጸመ ጥቃት የፓናማ ባንዲራ የነበረው የነዳጅ መርከብ በእሳት መጋየቱን ተከትሎ ሁለት መርከበኞች የት እንደደረሱ ሳይታወቅ ቀርተዋል፤ 23 መርከበኞች ደግሞ በሕይወት መትረፋቸውን የኦማን ባለሥልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን መርከቧ የባህር ማዕድን እንደገጠማት ብትገልጽም፣ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ግን ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በድሮን እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት ከየካቲት ወር መጨረሻ ጀምሮ በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣው የባህር ላይ ጥቃት አካል ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎች ለህልፈት እንዲዳረጉ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hormuz Strait keessatti doonii boba'aa kan dursee biyya Panamaa ture irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda ibidde ka'een namoonni lama badee jiru, 23 ammoo lubbuun oolanii jiru. Iran dooniin sun miinii galaanaatti bu'uu isaa kan ibsitu ta'us, waraanni Ameerikaa garuu haleellaan sun dorooneedhaan kan raawwatame ta'uu beeksisanii jiru. Miidhaan kun kanneen ganna kana keessa naannichatti raawwatamaa jiran keessaa tokko yoo ta'u, lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafatee jira.

title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
english: A report from the Pentagon’s inspector general confirms that the conflict with Iran has caused significant ammunition shortages and production delays for the US military. This finding contradicts claims by President Trump, who has insisted that American weapons supplies remain plentiful. While the administration dismisses these reports as false, the watchdog indicates that billions of dollars in spending and heavy usage of missile defense systems have strained the country's military inventory.
amharic: የፔንታጎን ዋና ኢንስፔክተር ያወጡት ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ጦርነት በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎች አቅርቦት ላይ እጥረት እና የልዩነት ችግር ፈጥሯል። ይህ ግኝት የአሜሪካ የጦር መሣሪያ ክምችት በቂ ነው የሚሉትን የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕን መግለጫዎች ይቃረናል። የአሜሪካ መንግሥት መረጃዎቹን ቢያስተባብልም፣ የገለልተኛ ኦዲተሩ ሪፖርት ከፍተኛ ወጪ መደረጉና የሚሳኤል መከላከያ ሥርዓቶች በብዛት ጥቅም ላይ መዋላቸው ለዚህ እጥረት መፈጠር ምክንያት መሆናቸውን ያረጋግጣል።
oromo: Gabaasni qorataa olaanaa Pentaagonii akka ibsetti, waraanni Iran waliin taasifamu kun gahaa ta'uu dhabuu meeshaalee waraanaa fi rakkoo dhiyeessii Amerikaa keessatti uumeera. Qorannoon kun himannaa Preezdaant Traamp kanneen meeshaaleen waraanaa biyyattii gahaa dha jedhan mormuun kan ka'e dha. Mootummaan gabaasa kana dhugaa miti jedhee haaluus, ogeeyyiin dhimmi kana hordofan garuu baasii guddaa fi fayyadama meeshaalee ittisa xiyyaaraa irraa kan ka'e kuusaan meeshaalee waraanaa Amerikaa hir'achuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Police crack down on protests against constitutional change in DR Congo
english: Protests broke out across the Democratic Republic of the Congo as citizens rallied against President Felix Tshisekedi’s proposed constitutional changes that could permit a third term in office. Police used tear gas and arrested several activists to suppress the demonstrations organized by opposition groups in cities like Kinshasa and Lubumbashi. This political tension comes as the nation continues to struggle with ongoing regional conflicts and a challenging health crisis.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ፌሊክስ ቺሴኬዲ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ የሚያስችለውን የህገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ በመቃወም በመላው ኮንጎ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተካሂደዋል። የፖሊስ ሰራዊት በኪንሻሳ እና በሉቡምባሺ ከተሞች የተነሱትን ሰልፎች ለመበተን አስለቃሽ ጋዝ የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎችንም በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ሀገሪቱ ቀድሞውኑ ካለባት የውስጥ ግጭት እና የጤና ቀውስ በተጨማሪ ይህ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት ተጨማሪ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Felix Tshisekedi yeroo sadaffaaf aangoo irratti akka turan kan taasisu jijjiirama seera bu’uuraa mormuun, biyyattii keessatti hiriirri mormii bal’aan geggeeffameera. Poolisiin magaalonni Kinshasaa fi Lubumbashi keessatti hiriira kana dhaabuuf gaazii imimmaansu fayyadamuun namoota baay’ee hidheera. Rakkoolee nageenyaa fi dhukkuba biyyattii keessa jiran cinaatti, mormiin kun mootummaa irratti dhiibbaa dabalataa uumeera.

title: More than 100,000 displaced as they flee violence in Yemen: UN
english: The United Nations reports that over 100,000 people have been displaced due to intensifying conflict between Houthi rebels and the Yemeni government. Many families are fleeing to Djibouti by crossing the dangerous Bab al-Mandeb strait, while those remaining face severe shortages of food, water, and shelter. The UN is calling for $14 million in urgent funding to provide humanitarian assistance to the displaced families and struggling host communities.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በየመን መንግስት መካከል እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ምክንያት ከ100,000 በላይ ሰዎች መፈናቀላቸውን አስታውቋል። ብዙ ቤተሰቦች አደገኛውን የባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ሰላጤ በማቋረጥ ወደ ጅቡቲ እየሸሹ ሲሆን፣ በየመን የቀሩት ደግሞ የምግብ፣ የውሃ እና የመጠለያ እጥረት ገጥሟቸዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ለተፈናቃዮች እና ለተጎጂ ማህበረሰቦች አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ለማቅረብ 14 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ድጋፍ እንደሚፈልግ ገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, loltoota Huutii fi mootummaa Yemen gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi hammaachuu isaa hordofee namoonni 100,000 ol ta’an buqqa’aniiru. Maatiin hedduun daandii galaana Baab al-Mandeb kan yaaddisaa ta’e qaxxaamuruun gara Jibuutitti baqachaa jiru; warri achi hafan ammoo dhabama nyaataa, bishaanii fi mana jireenyaatiin miidhamaa jiru. Dhaabbatichi maatii buqqa’anif gargaarsa namoomaa ariifachiisaa ta’e kennuuf qarshii miiliyoona 14 akka barbaadu beeksiseera.

title: How an Israeli cell orchestrated an anti-Qatar campaign
english: A report by Haaretz reveals that a group of around 30 Israeli influencers and former officials launched a secret campaign against Qatar following the October 7 attacks. The initiative aimed to pressure Qatar into using its influence with Hamas to help secure the release of hostages held in Gaza. While described as a civilian effort, experts suggest the operation likely had state backing and was intended to sway international public opinion.
amharic: የሃሬትዝ ጋዜጣ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው ከጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት በኋላ ወደ 30 የሚጠጉ እስራኤላውያን ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪዎች እና የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናት በኳታር ላይ ሚስጥራዊ ዘመቻ ከፍተው ነበር። ይህ ቡድን ኳታር በሃማስ ላይ ያላትን ተፅዕኖ በመጠቀም ታጋቾች እንዲለቀቁ ግፊት ለማድረግ ያለመ ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ዘመቻው በግለሰቦች የተጀመረ ቢባልም፣ ባለሙያዎች ግን ከዚህ እንቅስቃሴ ጀርባ የመንግስት እጅ ሊኖር እንደሚችል ይገምታሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni Haaretz akka ibsutti, haleellaa Sadaasa 7 booda namoonni Israa'el 30 ta'an fi ogeeyyonni kanaan duraa qindoominaan Qatar irratti duula icciitii tokko geggeessaniiru. Duulli kun Qatar dhiibbaa Hamas irratti qabdu fayyadamuun hidhamtoonni akka gadhiifaman dirqisiisuuf kan kaayyeffate ture. Duulli kun sochii namoota dhuunfaa ta'us, ogeeyyonni garuu duulli kun deeggarsa mootummaa kan qabu fi yaada uummata addunyaa jijjiiruuf kan qophaa'e ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Can China play peacemaker as Iran’s foreign minister heads to Beijing?
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is visiting Beijing to meet with his Chinese counterpart as tensions continue to rise following the US-Israel war on Iran. While Chinese President Xi Jinping is advocating for regional stability and encouraging BRICS nations to help mediate, China remains cautious about becoming directly involved in the conflict. Experts note that although Beijing seeks to protect its economic and energy interests, it typically avoids deep entanglement in foreign diplomatic disputes.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል መካከል ያለው ግጭት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ከቻይና አቻቸው ጋር ለመነጋገር ቤጂንግ ገብተዋል። የቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሰላም እንዲሰፍን ብሪክስ ሀገራት ሚና እንዲጫወቱ ቢጠይቁም፣ ቻይና በቀጥታ በግጭቱ ውስጥ ከመግባት ትጠነቀቃለች። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ቤጂንግ የራሷን የኢኮኖሚ ጥቅሞች ለመጠበቅ ብትፈልግም፣ በውጭ ሀገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ቀውሶች ውስጥ በጥልቀት ከመግባት ትቆጠባለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchii walitti buiinsa Iraanii fi Ameerikaa-Israa'el gidduutti uumame furuuf jedhamee gara biyya Chaayinaa imaleera. Preezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jiinpiing biyyoonni garee BRICS naannichatti nagaa akka buusan gaafatanii jiru, ta'us Chaayinaan qindoomina qabuun rakkoo kana keessa gadi fageenyaan seenuuf of eeggannoo gochaa jirti. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, Chaayinaan faayidaa dinagdee ishee eeggachuuf kan barbaaddu ta'us, walitti buiinsa biyyoota alaa keessatti akkaataa amalaa isheen duraan beekamtuun gadi fageenyaan seenuuf fedhii hin qabdu.

title: Election in Philippines’ Bangsamoro region ends in hung parliament
english: The first parliamentary election in the Philippines' Bangsamoro region has concluded without a single party winning a majority, leading to a hung parliament. Two rival factions that split from the Moro Islamic Liberation Front are now forced to negotiate a coalition to govern the region. While some residents expressed concerns about potential instability, leaders from both sides have indicated they are willing to work together to form a government.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ባንጋሳሞሮ ክልል ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተካሄደው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ውጤት አሸናፊ ፓርቲ ባለመገኘቱ ፓርላማው ስልጣን ሳይኖረው ቀርቷል። ከሞሮ እስላማዊ ነፃ አውጪ ግንባር የተከፋፈሉ ሁለት ተቀናቃኝ ቡድኖች ክልሉን ለማስተዳደር ጥምረት ለመፍጠር ድርድር ጀምረዋል። አንዳንድ ነዋሪዎች የጸጥታ ችግር ሊፈጠር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ቢኖራቸውም፣ የሁለቱም ወገን መሪዎች ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Filippiinsii kutaa Bangsaamooroo keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf kan gaggeeffame filannoon paarlaamaa, paartii tokkollee sagalee caalmaa argatee mootummaa dhaabuu hin dandeenyeen xumurameera. Gareewwan lama kan dur 'Moro Islamic Liberation Front' keessaa ba'an gidduutti wal dhabdee uumame irraa kan ka'e, amma mootummaa kutaalee walitti fiduuf mari'achuuf dirqamaniiru. title: Who is NFL billionaire Robert Kraft?
english: Robert Kraft is a prominent American billionaire best known as the owner of the NFL's New England Patriots. title: What are ‘space weapons’, which US says it has deployed into orbit?

title: Trump says AI safety fears a 'hoax' as he rejects calls for greater safeguards
english: Donald Trump has dismissed concerns regarding the safety of artificial intelligence, labeling such warnings as a hoax and rejecting calls for stricter industry regulations. He argued that instead of government guardrails, strong leadership is the key to mastering the technology to avoid falling behind global competitors like China. This stance counters recent suggestions from tech industry leaders who believe mandatory safety features, such as emergency shut-off switches, are necessary to mitigate potential risks.
